decisionLog.decision: Keep Slice 4D independent from scheduled refresh. No timer or automatic promotion enters this packet.

Treat zero-pointer to formal-pointer as a first-activation state transition. Rollback must preserve monotonic generation in an explicit transitional state; deleting the pointer and reopening expectedGeneration=0 is forbidden because it creates ABA replay risk.

Use an additive PostgreSQL migration for the explicit transitional pointer state. Active mode still requires a valid Manifest foreign key; transitional mode carries no active Manifest but retains the retail row and generation.

While formal mode is active, any missing or invalid pointer/Manifest/release fact returns 503 and never falls back to staging. Transitional reads are allowed only in the explicit pre-cutover or rollback state.

Phase 4C legacy evidence-sensitive semantic hashes remain immutable historical evidence. Cutover parity uses the corrected user-visible semantic signature plus exact provenance proof and release content integrity.
